answer.says: You are quite right, Mrs. Kapoor. I was in the error of assuming the structure would reveal its dysfunction without a witness. I am sitting. Please, tell me how the machinery actually grinds here, not how it is supposed to.
answer.thought: Her indignation is the most honest thing I have heard in days. She rejects the abstract 'system' because she has lived in the friction of it. I will listen to the concrete reality of the school's decay rather than debating its theoretical place in the ethical life.
